about: A Pong ball and paddle (UE 4.18), two public pastes on blueprintue.com posted ten minutes apart on 2017-11-15 under the same 'Pong - ' prefix, by an anonymous author: the hello world before Lock-On, a small, complete game to meet the method on before that complex example. Authors keep the rights to their pastes (blueprintue.com/terms-of-service): the .t3d texts stay out of git; this manifest is the record. nodes/chars/title/author/ue are the browser's own read of each page (2026-10-28 20:1xZ), held against what tools/online_sample.py reads.
